question:
Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word highlighted/ given in brackets in the below sentence.

In its broadest sense, science encompasses the knowledge and experience that (distinguishes) humans from animals.
(Clerk)
options: messed
differentiates
disorders
jumbles
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: differentiates

[distinguishes] - differentiates

Explanation:
The word "distinguishes" means to recognize or point out a difference between things. "Differentiates" is the most appropriate synonym as it also means to identify or mark the differences between entities.

separates, discerns, discriminates, characterizes, identifies

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

[distinguishes] – विभेदित करना – To recognize or point out differences
Example: *"His ability to distinguish between right and wrong makes him a wise leader."*

[messed] – गड़बड़ करना – To make untidy or disorganized
Example: *"The kids messed up the room while playing."*

[disorders] – विकार/अव्यवस्था – A state of confusion or disruption
Example: *"The sudden noise caused a disorder in the classroom."*

[jumbles] – मिलाना/अस्त-व्यस्त करना – To mix in a confused way
Example: *"She jumbled all the papers while searching for the document."*

[differentiates] – अंतर करना – To recognize or show the difference between things
Example: *"This test differentiates between skilled and unskilled workers."*

Conclusion:
Among the given options, "differentiates" is the best synonym for "distinguishes" because both words convey the idea of identifying or marking differences. The other options do not fit the context.

question:

(Selection Post Phase X Matriculation Level)
options: Practice
Oblige
Impress
Circulate
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Circulate

Distribute - Circulate

Explanation:
"Distribute" means to spread or give out something among a group of people, and "Circulate" also means to pass or spread something widely.
वितरित करने का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को समूह में बाँटना, और "Circulate" का अर्थ भी किसी चीज़ को व्यापक रूप से फैलाना है।

Other synonyms Words:
Disperse, Allocate, Scatter, Disseminate, Share

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Distribute – वितरित करना – To give out or deliver something to multiple recipients.
Example: "The teacher will distribute the test papers to the students."

Practice – अभ्यास करना – To perform an activity repeatedly to improve skill.
Example: "She practices the piano every day."

Oblige – मजबूर करना – To compel someone to do something.
Example: "He felt obliged to help his friend."

Impress – प्रभावित करना – To make someone feel admiration or respect.
Example: "Her speech impressed the audience."

Circulate – प्रसारित करना – To move or spread something around a group or area.
Example: "The manager circulated the memo among all employees."

Conclusion:
"Circulate" is the best synonym for "Distribute" because both words involve spreading something among multiple people or places. The other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:

Mangroves provide critical habitat for a diverse marine and terrestrial flora and fauna.

options: like
identical
similar
distinctive
solution:

varied, different, unique, assorted, heterogeneous

like – समान – similar to
Example: "She looks like her mother."

identical – एक समान – exactly the same
Example: "The twins have identical faces."

similar – मिलता-जुलता – resembling but not the same
Example: "Their opinions are similar but not identical."

distinctive – विशिष्ट – unique or different in nature
Example: "The bird has a distinctive red beak."

Conclusion:
"Distinctive" is the best synonym for "diverse" as it conveys the idea of variety and uniqueness, unlike "like," "identical," or "similar," which imply sameness.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

It is hard to draw clear lines of ________ (division) between work and leisure.
(CHSL Exam 2023 Tier I)
options: comprehension
administration
procrastination
demarcation
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: demarcation

division - demarcation

Explanation:
The word "division" refers to the act of separating or distinguishing between two things. "Demarcation" means setting boundaries or clear distinctions, making it the best synonym in this context.
विभाजन का अर्थ दो चीजों को अलग करना या उनके बीच अंतर करना है। "Demarcation" का अर्थ सीमाएँ निर्धारित करना या स्पष्ट अंतर करना है, जो इसे इस संदर्भ में सबसे उपयुक्त पर्याय बनाता है।

Other synonyms Words:
separation, distinction, boundary, partition, segregation

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

division – विभाजन – The act of separating something into parts or groups.
Example: "The division of tasks among team members improved efficiency."

comprehension – समझ – The ability to understand something.
Example: "His comprehension of complex topics is impressive."

administration – प्रशासन – The process of managing or organizing something.
Example: "The school administration handles all student-related matters."

procrastination – टालमटोल – The act of delaying or postponing tasks.
Example: "His procrastination led to incomplete assignments."

demarcation – सीमांकन – The act of setting clear boundaries or distinctions.
Example: "The demarcation between the two properties was marked by a fence."

Conclusion:
"Demarcation" is the best synonym for "division" in this sentence because it specifically refers to drawing clear lines or boundaries, which fits the context of distinguishing between work and leisure.
"Demarcation" इस वाक्य में "division" का सबसे उपयुक्त पर्याय है क्योंकि यह स्पष्ट सीमाएँ या अंतर खींचने को दर्शाता है, जो काम और अवकाश के बीच अंतर करने के संदर्भ में सही बैठता है।

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: abate

dwindle - abate

Explanation:
"Dwindle" means to gradually reduce in size, amount, or strength, and "abate" also means to become less intense or widespread. Both words convey the idea of decreasing over time.
"ड्विंडल" का अर्थ है धीरे-धीरे आकार, मात्रा या ताकत में कमी होना, और "एबेट" का अर्थ भी कम तीव्र या व्यापक होना है। दोनों शब्द समय के साथ कम होने का विचार व्यक्त करते हैं।

Other synonyms Words:
diminish, decline, decrease, wane, shrink

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

dwindle – घटना – To become gradually less until little remains.
Example: "The water supply began to dwindle during the drought."

enhance – बढ़ाना – To improve or increase the quality, value, or extent of something.
Example: "Adding spices can enhance the flavor of the dish."

ascend – चढ़ना – To go up or climb.
Example: "The hikers began to ascend the mountain at dawn."

extend – बढ़ाना – To make longer or larger.
Example: "The company decided to extend the deadline for submissions."

abate – कम होना – To become less intense or widespread.
Example: "The storm began to abate by evening."

Conclusion:
"Abate" is the best synonym for "dwindle" as both indicate a gradual reduction. The other options either mean the opposite (enhance, ascend, extend) or do not fit the context of decreasing.
